thread:
deploy-bot: [AUTO-ROLLBACK] Release 4.0.1 -> attempting rollback to 4.0.0. Trigger: deploy SLO alert (p95 > 1s for 4m) + 4% error-rate. See runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/rollback.

morgan: Noted. Do we have canary evidence? I see an uptick confined to /v1/generate paths.

jack: Canary metrics show error spike immediately after traffic shift at 03:12Z. Could be a config migration in 4.0.1.

ops-oncall: Before auto action completes, request a 3-minute freeze so SRE can check logs. To pause auto-rollback: `deployctl rollback hold --id=4.0.1-auto`

morgan: I agree with a short hold. If it's a config migration, we should prefer pin+manual rollback to avoid flip-flopping.

evie: FYI 4.0.1 included a change that toggles kernel-optimizations by default. That could explain failures on older drivers.

jack: If driver incompatibility, promoting 4.0.0 is safest. 4.0.0 has been running on all fleets for 48h.

ops-oncall: Holding auto-rollback now. `deployctl rollback hold --id=4.0.1-auto --reason="triage"`

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback paused. Waiting for manual decision within 3m.

morgan: I'll run a quick grep across logs for "kernel-select" and post snippets.

jack: Meanwhile, can we pin hosted and dedicated pools to 4.0.0 to prevent an accidental re-promote? Command: `redwoodctl pin --env=prod --version=4.0.0 --scope=all-pools`

ops-oncall: Executing pin now. `redwoodctl pin --env=prod --version=4.0.0 --scope=all-pools --note="investigating 4.0.1"`

morgan: Logs show repeated failure: "unsupported kernel flag: opt_v2" around the time of rollout. Tagging runtime team. Ticket INF-1302 created.

evie: Confirmed "+opt_v2" was added in 4.0.1 config. If drivers lack support, we get runtime errors that surface as 5xx. Hotfix options: revert the flag, or roll back.

jack: Ops, please run promote to 4.0.0 when ready. `deployctl promote --service=runtime-api --to-version=4.0.0 --force --wait`

ops-oncall: Promoting now. Will monitor metrics and keep rollback thread open for 30m.

deploy-bot: Promote started. Rolling traffic to 4.0.0.

morgan: After 90s p95 dropped below threshold. Error-rate trending down.

evie: I'll prepare a minimal hotfix PR to remove opt_v2 toggle and run it through a canary in staging.

jack: Draft customer line for post: "We rolled back 4.0.1 due to an unexpected runtime flag causing elevated errors on some drivers. Restored 4.0.0. We're preparing a fix and will share ETA."

ops-oncall: Pin confirmed. Promote finished. 100% traffic on 4.0.0. Health checks passing.

morgan: Thanks. I'll attach log extracts and the INF-1302 link to the incident doc.

sre-rotation-bot: Oncall handover in 30m. Please include this action in the handoff note.

evie: Opening a follow-up checklist: runtime-driver-compatibility matrix update, smoke tests for kernel flags, and staging canary for hotfix.

jack: Agree on scheduled blocked window for reattempt (no sooner than after driver compatibility tests).

ops-oncall: Closing auto-rollback thread. Will reopen if metrics regress.

morgan: customer note posted to status page and internal #incidents. Closing thread once handover updated.

jack: :thumbsup: Good runbook execution.

morgan: Closing.
